children.game_version: A game version of the lemon-tossing courtship ritual.

music_profile.sound_description: The music is driven by the bowed string sound of the masenqo and the percussive beat of the kebero, creating a fast-paced environment for dancing.

Coordinated forward and backward leg swings.
